serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Judi Health™ is an enterprise health technology company providing benefit administration solutions to employers, health plans, unions, and government entities. Built on Judi®, a proprietary enterprise health platform, Judi Health supports healthcare benefit administration across pharmacy, medical, dental, and vision. 
 
At its core, Judi® is a modern, modular, cloud-native, secure, end-to-end platform that enables Unified Claims Processing™, bringing together medical, pharmacy, dental, and vision claims administration through a single, unified platform. Built on a fully independent and programmable REST API architecture, Judi® supports benefit administration, claims processing, payments, reporting, care navigation, consumer engagement tools, data management, and AI-powered workflows. 
 
Judi Health delivers these capabilities through three complementary business lines: 
 
• Judi Rx™ – pharmacy benefit management and administration solutions. 
• Judi Care™ – medical, dental, and vision benefit administration solutions. 
• Judi Cloud™ – the licensed SaaS offering of Judi®, enabling benefits administration and Unified Claims Processing™ across a configurable system spanning eligibility, claims, payments, reporting, and healthcare data management. 
 
By unifying medical and pharmacy data within a single platform, Judi Health reduces administrative complexity, improves transparency and operational efficiency, and provides a scalable, single source of truth for healthcare administration. Supporting commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid organizations, Judi® delivers the flexibility, scalability, and connectivity required to power modern healthcare administration.
